name: ai-support-assistant-fastapi
description: AI assistant for customer-support teams: FastAPI + Pydantic api (code-first OpenAPI), RAG over company guidelines, React UI.

scripts.codegen: cd api && uv run python -m app.openapi_export && cd .. && pnpm --filter web api:types
scripts.lint: pnpm -r --parallel run lint && cd api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd api && uv run ruff format .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --parallel run typecheck && cd api && uv run mypy
scripts.test: pnpm -r run test && cd api && uv run pytest
